title: Base LM and Core Clients
summary: This module defines the abstract base class for Language Models (`BaseLM`) and provides core client functionalities, including flexible caching mechanisms (disk and memory) and configuration for LiteLLM logging. It enables robust integration with various LLM providers and efficient management of LLM interactions.

nodes.label: Configure Cache
nodes.title: Configure DSPy Cache
nodes.description: Sets up the global DSPy cache with specified disk and memory caching options, including size limits and pickle restrictions for security.

nodes.label: Initialize DSPy Cache
nodes.title: Initialize DSPy Cache
nodes.description: Retrieves or initializes the DSPy cache, falling back to a memory-only cache if disk initialization fails. Uses environment variables for configuration.

nodes.label: Enable LiteLLM Logging
nodes.title: Enable LiteLLM Debug Logging
nodes.description: Activates detailed debug logging for LiteLLM interactions within DSPy, providing verbose output for troubleshooting and monitoring.

nodes.label: Disable LiteLLM Logging
nodes.title: Disable LiteLLM Debug Logging
nodes.description: Deactivates detailed debug logging for LiteLLM interactions, setting the log level to error to reduce verbosity.

nodes.label: Base Language Model
nodes.title: Base Language Model Class
nodes.description: Abstract base class for all Language Models in DSPy, defining the interface for LLM calls, history management, and response processing. Subclasses must implement forward and aforward methods.

nodes.label: Synchronous Cache Wrapper
nodes.title: Synchronous Cache Decorator
nodes.description: A decorator that wraps synchronous function calls to enable caching. It checks the cache before execution and stores results after to optimize performance.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Cache Wrapper
nodes.title: Asynchronous Cache Decorator
nodes.description: A decorator that wraps asynchronous function calls to enable caching. It checks the cache before execution and stores results after to optimize performance.

nodes.label: Restricted Disk Storage
nodes.title: Secure Disk Serialization
nodes.description: A specialized disk storage class that enforces restricted pickle deserialization for security when loading cached data, preventing arbitrary code execution.

nodes.label: DSPy Global Cache
nodes.title: Global Cache Instance
nodes.description: The central cache instance used by DSPy for storing and retrieving LLM responses to optimize performance and reduce redundant API calls.

nodes.label: LiteLLM Client
nodes.title: LiteLLM Integration
nodes.description: An external client library used for interacting with various Language Model APIs, providing a unified interface for DSPy's LLM completion and embedding modules.

nodes.label: DSPy Global Settings
nodes.title: DSPy Configuration Settings
nodes.description: Global configuration settings for DSPy, including options for history management, caching behavior, and other operational parameters.

nodes.label: LM Completion & Embedding
nodes.title: LM Completion & Embedding Module
nodes.description: Module responsible for handling the actual LLM completion and embedding calls, often leveraging the LiteLLM client for diverse provider support.

groups.label: Cache Management
groups.title: DSPy Cache Management
groups.description: Handles the configuration, initialization, and operational aspects of DSPy's caching system, including both in-memory and disk-based storage with security features.

groups.label: Language Model Core
groups.title: Core Language Model Abstraction
groups.description: Provides the foundational abstract class for all Language Models within DSPy, defining the common interface and lifecycle for interacting with LLM providers.

groups.label: LiteLLM Logging
groups.title: LiteLLM Logging Configuration
groups.description: Manages the enabling and disabling of detailed logging for the LiteLLM client, which is used for interacting with various LLM APIs.
